UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile document containing student identity details.

academicLevel.description: Academic level e.g. Undergraduate Senior, High School.

targetExam.description: Target exam name or semester finals.

dailyGoalHours.description: Target study goal in hours per day.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last profile update.

UserPreferences.title: UserPreferences
UserPreferences.description: User preferences and study configuration stored in subcollection settings/preferences.

preferredStudyDays.description: Comma-separated or formatted list of preferred study days.

defaultStudyDurationMinutes.description: Default study session duration in minutes.

interfaceLanguage.description: Interface language (e.g. en, es, fr, de).

studyRemindersEnabled.description: Whether daily study notification reminders are enabled.

examRemindersEnabled.description: Whether upcoming exam countdown reminders are enabled.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last preferences update.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile document owned exclusively by the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/settings/preferences.description: Preferences document for user appearance, study goals, and reminders.
